docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY GOTLAND STORAGE MANAGEMENT, INC DBA TREASURE ISLAND DRIVE-UP AS TO DEFENDANT SNYDER, PAMELA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-10-2023 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) HANS FREDRIK ERVELL, PRESIDENT. FILED BY PLAINTIFF GOTLAND STORAGE MANAGEMENT, INC DBA TREASURE ISLAND DRIVE-UP

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-10-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAR-03-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF GOTLAND STORAGE MANAGEMENT, INC DBA TREASURE ISLAND DRIVE-UP IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY HANS FREDRIK ERVELL, PRESIDENT. DEFENDANT PAMELA SNYDER IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR DEFENDANT SNYDER TO MOVE EVERYTHING OUT OF THE UNIT BY FEBRUARY 28, 2023. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE MARCH 03, 2023 COURT DATE IF AGREEMENT IS BROKEN AND JUDGMENT WILL BE ISSUED. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. DEFENDANT AGREED TO THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT AND FOR PLAINTIFF RECEIVED CHECKS TO BE RETURNED. PLAINTIFF AGREED AND RETURNED CHECKS TO DEFENDANT IN THE COURT HALLWAY. PLAINTIFF HAS AGREED TO NOTIFY THE DEFENDANT BY EMAIL IF HE WILL APPEAR AT THE NEXT COURT DATE IF SETTLEMENT IS BROKEN. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: ERIC GROVER; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
